data.body: SCOPE-ADDITION (2026-05-20): RED test must assert that a freshly auto-filed advisory ticket carries BOTH tags: dir:<sanitized-path> (dedup key, existing behavior) AND directory-size-advisory (flat canonical tag for cross-cutting queries). Existing dedup behavior (one ticket per offending path) is unchanged and still under test. Source: 2026-05-20 implementation-plan remediation against epic c2cc-e3c4 SC↔AC coverage analysis.
